headline: India Trade Minister Goyal Criticizes EU Carbon Tax as Potential Disaster
summary: At the Berlin Global Dialogue, Indian Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal warned that the European Union's planned carbon tax risks inviting disaster for international trade.
why: The EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) imposes carbon tariffs on imported industrial goods, creating trade friction with major export nations.

impacts.name: Industrial Metals
impacts.why: Prospective EU carbon import levies threaten export margins for energy-intensive manufacturing exporters.
